name: tabs
useFor: Use to switch between views of the same thing on a page (Mailboxes, Contact rules, Custom domains). The track is as wide as its tabs and wraps when it runs out of room. Pass full to TabsList for two equal choices that fill a form's width (Login, Sign up).
constraints: A key that animates on first paint or on resize
source: Console src/components/ui/tabs.tsx and the Tabs theme (segmented, the sliding key)
title: Tabs
description: A lilac track of 13px regular labels; a white key with Shadow/S slides under the selected tab.
